ladder_transitions_plain_english: Two islands, boat-only: about 187,500 people reach Giftun and about 50,000 reach Ras Mohammed each year by boat — the visitor flow we can put economics on today.

Hurghada alone hosts about 1.9 million visitors a year; a conservative share take a reef or island day-trip, which is several times larger than the two sealed routes — before Sharm and the other Red Sea resorts are added.

Egypt welcomes about 15.8 million visitors a year spending about $15 billion; the marine-relevant slice — Red Sea day-trips, plus Nile and Alexandria waterfront once sourced — is the full opportunity the two starter routes sit inside.
